subject: OptionsLytics — post-call joint win plan and next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Zhang <emma@optionslytics.com>, Mark Collins <mark@optionslytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: OptionsLytics — post-call joint win plan and next steps

Hi Emma / Mark —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — summarizing the key takeaways and proposed next steps so we have a single place to reference. If anything below is off, flag it and I’ll update.

Quick recap of pain & goals you shared:
- Current inference costs are spiking during peak batch windows; primary goal is to reduce per-token spend by 30% while keeping latency under 250ms for user-facing flows.
- Critical throughput constraint for batch scoring (1M msgs/day) and need for predictable reserved capacity during month-end spikes.
- Data residency: primary data must remain in us-west region; security & auditability (SOC 2 + detailed access logs) are gating items.
- Decision process: technical POC → security review → procurement → exec signoff. Estimated decision owner: Mark (CTO) with procurement oversight.

Open items we discussed (asks for OptionsLytics):
1) Confirm the procurement contact and preferred contractual terms (SOW vs. term license).
2) Confirm any hard dates for production cutover or revenue-impacting milestones.
3) Any non-negotiable compliance requirements beyond SOC 2 (e.g., specific encryption/HSM needs).

Proposed joint plan (high level milestones) — provisional dates:
- Technical deep-dive (Redwood SEs + OptionsLytics infra): target 2026-11-30
- POC start (sandbox with representative schema & 1-week throughput test): start 2026-12-07
- Security questionnaire + evidence handoff (Redwood to provide SOC 2 attestation, audit logs example): delivered by 2026-12-10
- Procurement review & commercial terms agreed: target 2026-12-20
- Exec signoff and contract execution: target 2026-12-28

Immediate next steps I’d like to propose:
- I’ll send a short Joint Win Plan (MAP) workbook with explicit milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria — please review and push back by Thu, 2026-11-25.
- Schedule technical deep-dive: please share 30–60 minute slots you prefer for 2026-11-29 to 2026-12-01 — Vivek (cc’d) will lead that.
- Add procurement contact to thread (if different than mark/procurement@).

Attachments: optionslytics_requirements_summary.pdf (one-page recap of the environment and sample payloads).

Thanks — keen to keep momentum.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Emma Zhang <emma@optionslytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Collins <mark@optionslytics.com>, procurement@optionslytics.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OptionsLytics — post-call joint win plan and next steps

Thanks Rishi — this is great and matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement is looped in (procurement@optionslytics.com). They will want an initial cost estimate for the POC and any assumptions around reserved capacity vs. burst.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II is baseline — we also need confirmation on data-in-transit encryption and whether Redwood offers HSM-backed key management for sensitive datasets.
- Timeline: Mark is aligned to the end-of-year goal but procurement will likely push timelines into mid-Jan unless commercial terms are straightforward.

We’re available for the technical deep-dive on 2026-11-30 between 09:00–11:00 PT or 2026-12-01 after 13:00 PT. Which slot works for you?

Also, please include a short one-pager on cost modeling for the POC (tokens/hour estimate + expected unit costs) so procurement has something concrete to review.

Emma
Emma Zhang
Head of ML Platform | OptionsLytics
emma@optionslytics.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Zhang <emma@optionslytics.com>, Mark Collins <mark@optionslytics.com>, procurement@optionslytics.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OptionsLytics — post-call joint win plan and next steps

Appreciate the quick reply, Emma — confirmed on the 2026-11-30 deep-dive at 09:30 PT. Calendar invite to follow from Vivek.

I’ve attached the first version of the Joint Win Plan (OptionsLytics_JointWinPlan_v1.xlsx) — a concise MAP with milestones, owners, acceptance criteria, and dates. Summary of the MAP milestones below for easy reference: 

1) Technical deep-dive — 2026-11-30; Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood SE); Acceptance: agree on data ingress path + test harness.
2) POC provisioning & smoke test — 2026-12-07 to 2026-12-14; Owner: OptionsLytics engineering; Acceptance: sustained throughput test at 80% of target for 3 consecutive hours.
3) Security evidence delivery — 2026-12-10; Owner: Redwood Security; Acceptance: SOC 2 Type II report + example audit logs + KMS/HSM options doc.
4) Commercial review & term sheet — target 2026-12-20; Owner: OptionsLytics procurement / Rishi; Acceptance: signed term sheet or SOW.
5) Exec signoff & contract execution — target 2026-12-28; Owner: Mark Collins / Redwood legal; Acceptance: countersigned agreement.

Action items for OptionsLytics this week:
- Confirm procurement lead (if procurement@ is generic) so we can route the commercial packet.
- Share representative sample of the batch payload and a short list of peak-hour traffic expectations (JSON or CSV) — we’ll use this for sizing the POC.

What Redwood will deliver this week:
- Joint Win Plan workbook (attached) — please review and mark edits in the sheet.
- Cost modeling one-pager for the POC (tokens/hour assumptions + estimated spend).
- Security evidence pointer: a shared Drive folder with SOC 2 snapshot and KMS options (link included below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGhIJ
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/OPLY-2026-097

Attachments included: OptionsLytics_JointWinPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), optionslytics_requirements_summary.pdf (pdf).

If that all looks good, I’ll treat the 11/30 deep-dive as confirmed and we’ll use that session to walk the MAP and align acceptance criteria.

—
